summary: Discussion signals point to growing productionization of agent tooling (OpenCode, OpenHands, Grok Voice), emerging MCP/sandbox security concerns, and practical operator tricks for diagnosing agent behavior. | Vendor announcements and advisories on agents, sandboxes, security, and agent-hosting controls; official posts dominate — social reports missing. | GitHub snapshot: multiple major vendor releases for agent tooling (Vercel, Microsoft, Cloudflare, OpenAI, Anthropic, Langfuse, PostHog). Large OSS agent/runtime projects appear (HKUDS/nanobot, the-open-agent/openagent) but lack independent social/operator corroboration in this shard. | Package-shard sweep: many MCP/sandbox/eval/memory primitives and several vendor-backed extensions. No social/operator field reports in this shard; several single-repo packages need corroboration.
